introduction_markdown: Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions. Section I is designed to be answered in 1 hour and Section II in 1 1/2 hours; you are advised to divide your time accordingly. In Section II answer EITHER a, b and c OR d, e and f of each question. For your guidance the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation of your answers. In calculations you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Where necessary, assume: the acceleration due to gravity on the surface of the earth, $g = 10\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$; the speed of light in air, $c = 3.0\times10^{8}\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$; the charge on an electron, $e = 1.6\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm{C}$. Calculators are allowed.
incertitudes: Le sujet n'imprime pas de total par question : les totaux (`points` de l'exercice) sont la somme des points imprimés bloc par bloc (Section I : 6+4+8+6+9+7 = 40 ; Section II : 20 par question, soit 100 au total).

Les schémas, diagrammes et graphes demandés à l'élève (tracé de graphe, diagramme de rayons, champ électrique ou magnétique, tension d'entrée et de sortie, schéma de montage) ne sont pas produits comme figures du corrigé : ils sont décrits dans le corrigé (axes, points clés, forme).
Question 1(a) : le sujet imprime deux consignes à la suite sans repères ; elles ont été numérotées (i) et (ii) dans l'énoncé pour la lisibilité (2 points chacune, comme imprimé).
Question 1(b) : la pression est calculée comme la pression due à l'eau seule, $\rho g h$, sans ajouter la pression atmosphérique (le sujet demande « the pressure water exerts »).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) Define pressure and state its unit of measurement. *[2 marks]*

(ii) Explain why a sharpened edge knife cuts meat easily, when a constant force is applied. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Pressure** is the force acting **normally (perpendicular) to a surface per unit area** of that surface:

$$
P = \frac{F}{A}
$$

Its SI unit is the **pascal (Pa)**, where $1\,\mathrm{Pa} = 1\,\mathrm{N\,m^{-2}}$.

(ii) The edge of a sharpened knife has a **very small area of contact** $A$ with the meat. For the same force $F$, the pressure $P = F/A$ is therefore **very large**. This large pressure is greater than the meat can withstand, so the blade sinks into it and cuts it easily. A blunt edge has a larger area, gives a much smaller pressure and does not cut.

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate the pressure water exerts at a depth of $6\,\mathrm{m}$ in a pond given that the density of water is $1000\,\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Pressure due to a liquid column: $P = \rho g h$, with $g = 10\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$ (given on the front page).

$P = 1000 \times 10 \times 6 = 60\,000\,\mathrm{Pa}$

**The pressure of the water at 6 m depth is $6.0\times10^{4}\,\mathrm{Pa}$ (60 kPa).**
